memories.content: Always run npm run checks:branch:fix before implementation work to keep branch validation deterministic.
Before architecture changes, search durable memory for prior decisions, conventions, and root causes.
Calibration scorecard metrics should be tracked consistently in fixture-driven evaluation reports.
Root cause: local environment probe can return detached HEAD when repository history is checked out at prior commit.
Use fixture-specific project scopes for eval seeding to avoid cross-suite contamination.
Prefer concise handoff summaries that include explicit validation outcomes and report links.
